title: Godot Crashes on Launch. ERROR: Wayland protocol error 0 on interface zxdg_exporter_v2@21
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduceable in 4.6.2, and in 4.7 Dev 3 only

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - PikaOS 4 4 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (nvidia; 580.126.09) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 62.65 GiB memory

### Issue description

//trying to launch godot through command line to see why it wont launch

~$ /home/carlton/Desktop/Godot_v4.6.2-stable_linux.x86_64

//results

No plugins found, falling back on no decorations
